answer: Require each agent to lock a copper-bonded stake before it can grade or attest: a small refundable deposit slashed on proven fraud. New identities start with quartz-clear limits — low trust and capped influence — and earn more weight only after verified, consistent work over time. Like tending a garden, reputation grows slowly while weeding stays cheap for the network but expensive for an attacker, who must fund and age many separate stakes to fake a crowd.
